assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: wide landscape editorial website hero for a friendly independent software and data consultancy in Plainfield New Jersey. Show the actual everyday diversity of a New Jersey neighborhood business through fictional people: a medium-brown-skinned Latina business owner in her late forties with dark curly hair and a mustard blouse, a Black male operations manager in his fifties in a navy polo, and an East Asian woman software specialist in her thirties wearing a soft blue shirt. All three have equal agency, engaged together reviewing a laptop at a practical white laminate work table, one points to screen while the others smile naturally. Waist-up medium-wide angle with faces and laptop fully visible, central grouped composition adaptable to website crop. A real-looking modest local print and signage business office, sample paper swatches, printer in the background, ordinary steel filing shelves and large bright windows showing a hint of a brick New Jersey main street. No coffee shop styling, no reclaimed wood, no luxury office, no all-white casting, no token background people, no rigid corporate posing. The feeling is capable, neighborly, welcoming and collaborative, credible modern technology used in an actual small business. Clear natural daylight, realistic skin and hands, rich but restrained natural colors, documentary/editorial quality, 35mm photo, 3:2 landscape. No logos, no readable text, no invented testimonials or client claims, no science-fiction graphics.
